channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shaquille Harrison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shaquille Harrison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Shaquille Harrison
item.description:
Ham on one of LAL’s roster moves:

“Shaquille Harrison can score, play-make and guard multiple positions; he’s played real NBA minutes and we saw opportunity if anything should happen health wise that we can throw right into the mix.”

Darvin Ham on Shaquille Harrison, Apr 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Donovan Mitchell, Shaquille Harrison
item.description:
Eric Walden:Joe Ingles, on the Jazz's addition of Shaq Harrison:

“I didn’t know he had a broken hand — he looked fine today! … When we signed him, Donovan mentioned he had some bad memories of him. … … It was good to see him and have him around today.”

Joe Ingles on Donovan Mitchell, Shaquille Harrison, Dec 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: John Paxson on Ryan Arcidiacono, Shaquille Harrison
item.description:
Paxson said about releasing Cameron Payne.

“The reality is both Arch (Ryan Arcidiacono) and Shaq (Harrison) have outplayed him. They fit what we want to do. Cam had some struggles with his foot and trying to get him back.”

John Paxson on Ryan Arcidiacono, Shaquille Harrison, Jan 4, 2019. Source: NBA.com.
